## Notes

- The [[Illusion of Competence]] refers to our belief in our competence without being tested on our actual competence.

### Active Note Taking

```timestamp
01:55
```

- Cal Newport's QEC (Question, Evidence, Conclusion) method
conclusion = dot
evidence = dash

### Atomic Notes

```timestamp
 03:15
 ```

- atomic notes are notes containing a single idea.
- the benefit of atomic notes is that they can be rearranged in any direction
- each part of the QEC gets its own note

### Connected Notes

```timestamp
 04:31
 ```

- connect notes to beyond their particular settings

### The Compass of Zettelkasten Thinking

```timestamp
 04:60
 ```

north: where does this idea originate
west: what is similar to this idea
east: what is opposite this idea
south: where can this idea lead
